narrative:
## Handover Summary — Workforce & Efficiency

Headcount roll-forward validated: hires, departures, transfers and open positions by month.

## Key Decisions
• Targeted retention awards for three senior private bankers
• +2 AML analysts for MoraBanc SA KYC volumes (about EUR 180K a year)
• 3 back-office roles redeployed to Spanish operations instead of external hires

## Recommendation for Admin Expenses
Staff cost growth should slow to about 6% in FY2027 for the efficiency ratio to reach 58%.

signals.title: Efficiency ratio 60.1% vs EU average 55.0%
signals.excerpt: Staff costs +26% to €60.4M with 584 people, 30% more than three years ago.
